lines: Apni marzi se kahan apne safar ke hum hain
couplets.en: When have we ever chosen our own course?

lines: Apni marzi se kahan apne safar ke hum hain
Rukh hawaon ka jidhar ka hai udhar ke hum hain
couplets.en: Our course is scarcely ours to choose, for we go where the winds turn.

lines: Pehle har cheez thi apni magar ab lagta hai
couplets.en: Once everything felt like ours, but now the feeling has changed.

Apne hi ghar mein kisi doosre ghar ke hum hain
couplets.en: Once everything felt like ours, yet now, even in our own home, we seem to belong somewhere else.

lines: Waqt ke saath hai mitti ka safar sadiyon se
couplets.en: For centuries the dust has traveled alongside time.

lines: Waqt ke saath hai mitti ka safar sadiyon se
Kis ko maloom kahan ke hain kidhar ke hum hain
couplets.en: For centuries the dust has traveled alongside time, and who knows where we come from or where we belong?
